title: Site Leadership Coach: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Seals were bought locally without a specification for two years.
No check stopped an untested pump returning to service.

sections.heading: How the site set this up

items.text: Seals were bought locally without a specification [FND-0003]. Nothing in the return-to-service step asked for a test [FND-0002]. The pump restarted untested [FND-0001].
Buying seals locally without a specification had become routine; the findings record no challenge to it [FND-0003].

items.decision: Require a specification for every critical-spares order
items.trade_offs: Longer lead times against fewer unknown parts.

items.name: Critical spares bought to specification
items.measure: % of critical-spares orders with a specification reference

items.text: Ask for the leak-test record at every pump walk-through.
